cmd:
echo ===LINENUM-10-09-MARKER===; grep -n "10.09" /var/log/vps-pipeline.log | head -3
echo ===FIRST-429-AFTER-MARKER===; awk '/10\.09/{found=1} found && /429/{print NR": "$0; c++; if(c>=3) exit}' /var/log/vps-pipeline.log
echo ===LOGROTATE===; ls -la /etc/logrotate.d/ 2>/dev/null | grep -i vps
echo ===FILE-CTIME===; stat /var/log/vps-pipeline.log | grep -E 'Birth|Modify'
echo ===EVERY-429-BLOCK-TODAY===; grep -n "429" /var/log/vps-pipeline.log | awk -F: '{print $1}' | tail -100 | head -1
echo ===TIMESTAMPS-AROUND-FIRST-CONSISTENT-429===; sed -n '250000,250030p' /var/log/vps-pipeline.log
echo ===COUNT-SUCCESSFUL-FETCH-LAST-2H===; grep -E "HTTP Error 429|^[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}  INFO      (ecmwf_ifs|icon_eu|gfs_global) " /var/log/vps-pipeline.log | tail -60
